etapes.texte: From spotting an opportunity to sending your application, without ever leaving the platform.
etapes.compteTexte: Signing up is free and takes a few seconds. It opens the full catalogue and all your tools.
etapes.chercherTexte: Filter by type, sector or location, save what interests you, and get an alert before every deadline.
etapes.candidaterTexte: Build your CV inside the app, let the assistant improve it, then apply in one click.

fonctionnalites.titre: Far more than a list of adverts
fonctionnalites.texte: The tools that are usually missing between spotting an opportunity and applying for it.
fonctionnalites.cvTexte: Build your CV online, or import an existing PDF: the details are extracted automatically.
fonctionnalites.assistantTexte: An assistant that knows the catalogue: it points you in the right direction, reviews your CV and helps prepare your applications.
fonctionnalites.alertesTexte: A notification before the opportunities you follow close. No more missed deadlines.
fonctionnalites.messagerieTexte: Talk directly to the organisations that publish, without going through an outside channel.
fonctionnalites.retoursTexte: Members share their experience of an opportunity: the process, the timings, how it felt.
fonctionnalites.partageTexte: Every opportunity has its own page, preview and image: a link shared on WhatsApp displays properly.
fonctionnalites.installableTexte: Install Noken Declic on your phone straight from the browser. Readable offline too.
fonctionnalites.donneesTexte: Your profile belongs to you. You choose what is visible, and you can delete everything.

assistant.texte: The assistant can see published opportunities and your CV. It cites its sources and never points you to an opportunity that does not exist.
assistant.point1: Finds the opportunities that match your profile
assistant.point3: Explains the criteria of a scholarship or a programme
assistant.point4: Helps you prepare answers to interview questions
assistant.question: I'm finishing a computer science degree in Ziguinchor. What would you suggest?
assistant.reponse: Three options match your profile in Casamance — an internship, a certified training course and an incubation programme.

recentes.texte: Updated continuously by the team and by partner organisations.

ancrage.texte: Opportunities in the south of the country are rarely relayed elsewhere. Noken Declic gathers them in the same place as those from Dakar, so there is no need to look in ten different places.
ancrage.photoAlt: Three young people browsing opportunities together on Noken — the opportunity is right here.
ancrage.casamanceTexte: Ziguinchor, Kolda, Sédhiou — local opportunities appear on the same footing as any other.
ancrage.structuresTexte: Universities, associations, companies and programmes that genuinely recruit in the region.
ancrage.reluesTexte: Every listing is verified and links back to its official source where one exists.

mobile.texte: Noken Declic installs straight from the browser — no app store, no updates to manage. Pages you have already opened stay available when the network drops.

accueil.campagneAlt: Noken — your future starts here. Thousands of opportunities are waiting: verified listings, easy search, personalised alerts.

faq.q1: Do I need an account to browse opportunities?
faq.r1: Yes. Browsing opportunities requires an account, which is free and takes seconds to create. It also gives you favourites, the CV builder, alerts, the assistant and messaging.
faq.r2: Yes. Creating an account and using the platform are free for people looking for opportunities.
faq.q3: How do I install the app on my phone?
faq.r3: Open the site in your mobile browser, then choose “Add to Home Screen”. The app installs without going through an app store.
faq.q4: Can I browse opportunities without an internet connection?
faq.r4: Pages you have already visited remain readable offline. New opportunities need a connection to load.
faq.r5: Partner organisations and the Noken Declic team. Every listing names its author and links to the official source where one exists.
faq.q6: How do I report an incorrect or expired listing?
faq.r6: From the listing's own page, or through the “Reports” area of your account. Every report gets a reply.

appel.texte: Create your account for free. You'll find your favourites, your CV and your alerts there, on phone and on computer alike.

installation.autreEtape2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
installation.autreEtape3: Confirm — the icon appears straight away.
